title: Publish the measured SQLite COMMIT duration before transaction cleanup can block
outcome: While rollback or transaction cleanup is in progress, diagnostics expose the COMMIT duration already measured without changing SQL, cleanup or error behavior.
acceptance: The live commit_cleanup sample publishes the already-measured sqliteCallUs before dropping the transaction; cleanup duration stays unavailable until measured.
Deterministic coverage proves live visibility during cleanup and preserves COMMIT result and rollback behavior.
